texte.ISO # est la SEULE des quatre références: ISO # is the ONLY one of the four references in this space that issues a certificate. The GDPR, NIS # and the CRA are law: you comply with them, and nobody hands you an attestation. This path answers the only question that concerns you before committing a budget: this certificate — who will you show it to, and what can prevent you from obtaining it?
